apps.name: Trappstore
apps.longDescription: Trappstore is a private window for Android apps. Sideload it once. Patches land here when you pull up. No Play. No account. No USB.

apps.longDescription: Offline-first navigation built specifically for Queensland roads. Calm cockpit, hazard awareness, rerouting, ETA confidence, speed warnings, custom place icons. Built for drivers who want the road — not a feed.
